title: fix(doctor): archive orphan transcripts after deferred imports
body:
Related: #147711, #149308. Proof prerequisite: #149913.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes orphan legacy transcripts remaining in the active sessions directory when a verified session import is deferred for plugin migrations and later settles.

## User Impact

Completing the deferred migration archives existing orphan JSONL inputs as protected recovery originals, preserving their bytes and avoiding repeated legacy-file findings.

## Why This Change Was Made

Retained settlement correctly refuses uncaptured sources (#147711). Missing-transcript warnings now permit verified deferred receipts (#149308), exposing the missing orphan inventory. Doctor now includes existing unreferenced JSONL identities in that receipt, excluding paths referenced by other known indexes. Both archive guards and byte verification remain intact. No schema, dependency, configuration, CLI, or retention change.

Shared legacy indexes also require one physical archive move to be recorded for every receipt that captured that source. The archive planner now associates all captured owners before publication; completion and retry use those same records. Each owner sees its archived paths in the Doctor report, while aggregate counts count each physical path once.

## Evidence

- The expanded regression failed before the fix: orphans remained with and without missing-transcript warnings, and changing an uncaptured orphan went undetected. All repaired cases pass. The authored change passed 64 focused tests, `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`, `pnpm build`, and scoped-clean Codex P1 local and branch reviews.
- Published `2026.8.1` driver inspection confirmed capture of all 24 orphan inputs: 12 per agent, with every recorded SHA-256 matching its original bytes.
- The F1 composition passed 210 tests, a full build, and scoped-clean Codex P1 review. Proof head `9bf78f3f2e962f920142a6bfad03fa9174de3961` combines authored head `810b8a4af75ef32eae91cc08382d4b12ee9b2058` with F1 `7fb986abc897477b6d20e13a17e1dc0e6f0c3960` from #149913. **The F1 commits were applied for the proof run only and are not included in this PR.**
- The September 16 row2 rerun used the published `2026.8.1` updater and that verified candidate tarball, with the unchanged `sqlite-volume` fixture and archive assertions. Preflight confirmed at least 20 GiB free and no other running survivor container. The minimum recorded free space was 22.14 GiB; no disk stop occurred.

| Docker phase | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline installation, configuration, fixture seeding, and volume baseline assertions | Passed |
| Candidate update and `assertUpgradeVolumeMigrated` | Passed: 4800 sessions, 23890 events, 2200 cron jobs, and SQLite integrity assertions |
| Final transcript archive counts | **Passed: main 2403 (2391 + 12), ops 2402 (2390 + 12); 12 orphan archives each; both legacy indexes removed** |
| Post-Doctor config validation and survival assertion | Passed; volume counts reverified |
| Initial Gateway startup / health / readiness / status | Passed; startup 38s, within the unchanged 90s budget |
| Volume Gateway RPC / history | Passed: 8 conversations across 2 agents |
| Gateway stop | Passed |
| Doctor idempotence gate | **Failed: Doctor completed in 100s, exceeding the unchanged 60s budget** |
| Post-idempotence state recheck, restart, and restarted history/survival | Not reached after the budget failure |

The missing archive-count proof is now established, including all 24 orphan archives. The complete row still exits 1 at the idempotence time budget; post-idempotence validation and restart proof remain gaps. No assertion or idempotence/startup budget was weakened, and no additional row was run. Native summary, phases, diagnostics, logs, and archive snapshots were retained; the owned container, image, runtime, and install trees were cleaned up.

The line-cap follow-up moves index, orphan, transcript, and sibling-artifact identity capture into `src/infra/deferred-plugin-session-sources.ts`, retaining the Doctor call boundary and both archive guards. The same implementation passed all 64 focused tests and the 210-test proof-only F1 composition again, `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`, the current-main line-cap checker, and `pnpm build`. The final import-order adjustment is formatting-clean and both it and the final branch passed scoped-clean Codex P1 review. Mechanical merges with the inspected current main and F1 heads succeed.

For the CI merge tree, `doctor-session-sqlite.ts` shrinks from 1931 to 1911 counted lines, below main's 1926-line baseline. On the authored branch it shrinks from 1913 to 1893. The line-cap checker derives its baseline from Git; no baseline or suppression changed. Docker evidence above remains tied to its recorded earlier proof head.

Current authored head: `1014a42e8c2434e5c5a76b0af3eaad2b4e411b52`.

### Shared-owner settlement correction

Addresses [ClawSweeper's exact-head finding](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/150015#issuecomment-5696950467) on `fb2ae75ce97551cd3fb99a9c4ff84d3905f7cbee`: both agents captured the orphan, but only the first target had its archive mapping. The second target's receipt verification failed after the physical move. The correction stays at archive planning; target-scoped lookup and both captured-source guards are unchanged. There is one physical move, with planned/completed records for every captured owner, and no extra copy or retry loop.

The new `doctor-session-sqlite.shared-orphan.test.ts` uses two agents sharing a real temporary legacy index. It exercises capture, deferred settlement, both owners' receipt verification, and retry after an injected index-publication failure. Both owners resolve the same archive, its original bytes and single-link identity are preserved, per-owner reports include the shared move, and totals count one orphan archive. Existing test files did not grow.

Pre-fix output (temporary path shortened):

```text
Tests  2 failed (2)
Caused by: Error: Retained session migration source changed: …/sessions/deleted-orphan.jsonl.
Resolve the source conflict before running openclaw doctor --fix again; the verified import was not replayed.
```

The normal case failed in post-archive receipt verification. The interrupted case hit that same error before reaching its intended index-publication interruption.

- Post-fix: all 297 focused owner/sibling tests passed across five files, including shared publication recovery and restore cases. The two new regression cases passed again after their final callback binding cleanup.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed. The current-main `check-line-cap-ratchet.mts` also passed against the branch fork: five changed source files, no new violations or over-cap growth. Doctor has 1893 counted lines against the 1908-line fork baseline; the merged-main count is 1911 against 1926.
- Fresh Codex local and branch-mode P1 reviews are scoped-clean. The correction changes no module boundaries, schemas, configuration, CLI options, or dependencies; the prior full-build evidence remains tied to the extraction revision.
- This correction adds production +22/-10 (net +12) and tests +141/-0. No suppression or baseline changed.

ClawSweeper Rank-up moves:

- **Applied:** repair multi-owner archive mappings and add deferred completion/retry regression coverage.
- **Deferred to the landing composition:** repeat-Doctor, preserved-state, and restarted-history live proof. This lane was ordered to make the focused shared-owner repair and stop at the PR after CI attachment. The earlier 100s/60s idempotence failure and unreached restart checks remain explicit gaps; no maintainer waiver is claimed.

### CI inventory maintenance

Registered `doctor-session-sqlite.shared-orphan.test.ts` in the existing `agentic-commands-doctor-sessions-cron` inventory assertion. Discovery already routed it to that owner; the expected inventory omitted it. The completeness and isolation assertions remain intact, and no other lane changed.

```text
✓ |tooling| test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan.test.ts > scripts/lib/ci-node-test-plan.mts > keeps Doctor session SQLite owners complete and isolated 536ms
Tests  79 passed (79)
```

All 297 focused Doctor tests passed again, followed by `node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- test/scripts/ci-node-test-plan.test.ts`. This follow-up changes one inventory line only (production +0/-0; tests +1/-0). No new autoreview was required under the explicit inventory-only ruling.
